name: Athenaeum InterContinental Athens
positioning: City InterContinental on Syngrou Avenue in Athens (officially InterContinental Athenaeum Athens), known for its own collection of works by prominent Greek artists, with an outdoor pool and the Acropolis about 2 kilometers away
best_for: Art lovers who want a hotel filled with works by prominent Greek artists
Travelers who want a city base within reach of the Temple of Olympian Zeus and the Acropolis

facts.text: The hotel is at Syngrou Avenue 89-93 in Athens.
A collection of fine art owned by the hotel is exhibited throughout the hotel, in both public and private spaces, as an integral part of its design.
The hotel's art collection features authentic works by prominent Greek artists.
Classic rooms combine classic design, contemporary furnishings and original Greek art.
Classic rooms have a marble bathroom.
The outdoor pool has a two-tier sun deck.
I-Spa is inspired by Greek hospitality and the harmony of natural beauty.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness centre, with optional dedicated personal trainers.
Cafezoe, the breakfast restaurant, was designed by interior designer Tony Chi.
Artlounge in the lobby has live piano music on winter evenings.
The Temple of Olympian Zeus is within walking distance of the hotel.
The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.

highlights.text: A collection of fine art owned by the hotel, with authentic works by prominent Greek artists, is exhibited throughout its public and private spaces.
The suite categories include a Luxury Acropolis View Suite.
Classic rooms combine classic design, contemporary furnishings and original Greek art, with a marble bathroom.
The outdoor pool is an urban escape surrounded by loungers, with a two-tier sun deck.
The Temple of Olympian Zeus is within walking distance of the hotel.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal, open from May to mid-October, weather permitting.
The Acropolis is about 2 kilometers from the hotel, so it is not on the doorstep.
WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may not suit guests seeking a quiet retreat.
